_notes.cli: grok 1.0.8 (95f4d45270) at C:/Users/Administrator/.grok/bin/grok.exe; CLI is behind the alpha channel (latest 1.0.40) but the model catalog is live.
_notes.fresh_session: headless -p is one-shot non-interactive; every dispatch gets a new sessionId; no --continue/--resume is ever passed, so no prior context is carried.
_notes.prompt: prompt_via=argv with -p {prompt}: the tested session receives exactly the two-line dispatch text (workdir + PROMPT.md pointer). No discipline, no contract, no rubric summary.
_notes.cwd: --cwd {workdir} plus the process cwd both pin the session to the external workdir; F:\benchmark never appears in the dispatch.
_notes.permission: --permission-mode bypassPermissions because headless has no approver; the file/network boundary is the CLI host, not an enforced sandbox. --sandbox is accepted but has no enumerable profiles (INVALID value is ignored), so no workspace-write profile could be pinned.
_notes.evidence: --output-format json makes stdout.log the provider trace: sessionId, requestId, usage, num_turns, total_cost_usd and modelUsage (observed serving id grok-4.7-build).
_notes.isolation: external-cwd + harness observation only; isolation_verification stays unverified per protocol 2.0.
_notes.environment_caveat: the grok host loads the user's 27 user/bundled skills (creative-writing, novel-creator, threejs-frame-conventions, ...) regardless of cwd; repo project instructions are NOT loaded because the workdir has no git root and no AGENTS.md above it.
